description: Late accounts with many names, for example Sālim b. Aḥmad, and Hebrew numerals. The paper features two lines of sewing holes. Mentions the "peasants/farmers" (fallāḥīn) of Minyat al-Mukhliṣ, a small town in the Nile Delta, in in the heading on the upper right corner of the verso. A variety of entries mention dates with Hijri months, but no years are clearly provided. (MCD with information from CUDL)
description_he: חשבונות מאוחרים עם שמות רבים, כגון סאלם בן אחמד, וספרות עבריות.
